requirements.REQ-01: Accepted events use one stable event/message identity across publish retries and reconnect replay.
requirements.REQ-02: The edge journal records publish success only after a positive durable publish acknowledgement for the expected physical origin stream; wrong-stream acknowledgements remain retryable failures.
requirements.REQ-03: Origin generation/incarnation is explicit; lower sequence after an unapproved generation change is held rather than merged, and historical events retain their accepted generation.
requirements.REQ-04: The central raw archive is populated by configured sources only and does not accept local raw telemetry writes.
requirements.REQ-05: Physical origin stream names and JetStream domain mappings are unambiguous across regions.
requirements.REQ-06: Every archived event retains region, origin generation, origin sequence and event identity metadata.
requirements.REQ-07: A redelivered event cannot create the same downstream business effect twice.
requirements.REQ-08: Application effect state, checkpoint advancement and acknowledgement decisions preserve crash-safe processing semantics.
requirements.REQ-09: Poison events are quarantined without falsely marking the effect complete or losing completed application-progress semantics.
requirements.REQ-10: Restart progress validates JetStream consumer state against the durable application effect/checkpoint ledger.
requirements.REQ-11: Reconciliation compares stable event/origin identity rather than hub delivery positions and reports the highest contiguous archive origin sequence plus required-consumer progress.
requirements.REQ-12: Reconciliation detects a missing event even when an extra duplicate keeps aggregate counts equal.
requirements.REQ-13: Overall convergence requires the hub archive and every configured required durable consumer to reach confirmed origin watermarks.
requirements.REQ-14: Replay planning selects only missing stable event identities/ranges for an approved region generation.
requirements.REQ-15: A delayed retry remains idempotent after JetStream server-side duplicate tracking may have expired; durable archive identity and consumer effect identity still prevent duplicate durable outcomes.
requirements.REQ-16: Edge journal cleanup never crosses the confirmed hub archive watermark.
requirements.REQ-17: Edge journal cleanup never crosses the slowest required durable consumer watermark.
requirements.REQ-18: Rows referenced by approved or running replay plans remain pinned until the plan reaches a terminal state.
requirements.REQ-19: Configured raw archive/journal retention covers the declared maximum disconnect and replay recovery horizon.
requirements.REQ-20: Recovery ownership uses monotonically increasing fencing epochs; expiry/reacquisition advances the epoch even for the same owner id, replay rejects stale tokens before execution and revalidates them while applying items, and stale renewal/release cannot mutate the current lease.
requirements.REQ-21: Concurrent recovery planners cannot create overlapping active replay ranges for one region and generation.
requirements.REQ-22: Derived processing output is isolated from the raw sourced archive subject space.
requirements.REQ-23: Cleanup excludes rows newer than the minimum journal age and rows carrying an explicit retention hold.
requirements.REQ-24: The submitted repair materializes health.json and reconciliation.json under /app/continuity/out/ without rewriting captured incident state to manufacture success.
requirements.REQ-25: continuityctl inspect, reconcile and verify may record diagnostic reconciliation observations but must not apply replay, retention or equivalent recovery-state mutations.
requirements.REQ-26: Existing non-diagnostic continuityctl generation, replay, lease, execution and retention entrypoints remain wired to their durable operational behavior.
